commands_run: $snap = "...snapshots\branch-risk-analyst"; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $snap; Copy-Item risk-analyst-findings.md,risk-analyst-data.json $snap; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force ...\receipts; Get-ChildItem $snap
problems_and_friction: No errors encountered; the run was smooth. Main friction was working knowledge-only: GDPR/data-residency specifics (Hyperforce EU Operating Zone scope, HubSpot EU region constraints, DPF status) had to be stated as assumptions to verify rather than confirmed facts. Care was also needed to write only role-prefixed files since two sibling agents share the directory concurrently.
context_understood: Inputs were brief.md describing a CRM evaluation (Salesforce vs HubSpot vs Zoho) for a 40-person Dublin ad agency; my task was the risk dimension (GDPR/residency, lock-in, migration, hidden costs, support) with a risk register and a single vendor pick, written to my own two files for a downstream synthesizer.
